svg.text: ☁ Cloud WAN — Network Segment (Phase 3 — Definitive Connectivity Layer)
Replaces all VPC Peerings · Segment-based routing (Dev / QA / Prod / SharedServices) · Attachments per provider VPC · No transitive peering needed
Route53 PHZ resolves svc-name.internal → SN-E IP
Consumer's SN-E resolves to Lattice link-local address
Outbound SG must allow Lattice managed prefix
Role NOT in policy → 403 Forbidden · Role in policy → ALLOW
Listener Rule → Target Group → ECS Task
HTTP :80 or HTTPS :443 listener routes to registered targets
Auth Policy — DENY ALL by Default
Hub TaskRole → API Provider svc ✓ ALLOW
Only Service Associations — no VPC Associations
No outbound peering dependencies · Clean isolation
Provider VPCs — One per Application (Pure Provider Model)
DENY ALL by default · only Analytics TaskRole ALLOWed
Calls App3, App4, App5 via SN-E (SigV4 signed)
DENY ALL · ALLOW Hub TaskRole + Agents TaskRole
Phase 1: :3306 direct → Phase 2: Lattice Service (no raw port)
Hub TaskRole → 403 Forbidden (not in Auth Policy)
Zero Trust proven: adjacent app DENIED at identity layer
VPC Association = consumer VPC joins Service Network via SN-E
Service Association = provider VPC registers its Lattice Service
Auth Policy: DENY ALL by default · every caller listed by IAM role
SigV4 on every request · Listener replaces ALB · pure provider VPCs
